record.original_question: For left-linear term-rewriting systems, can one give decidable criteria that guarantee the Church-Rosser property, such as criteria based on whether each critical pair t approximately s satisfies s reducing to t in one parallel step, s reducing to t by zero or one steps, or one side reducing to the other by zero or one steps?

evidence.quote: Give decidable criteria for left-linear rewriting systems to be Church-Rosser.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A term-rewriting system (TRS) is a finite set R of rewrite rules l → r over terms built from a signature Σ and a countable set of variables, where l is not a variable and every variable of r occurs in l. The TRS is left-linear if no variable occurs more than once in any left-hand side l. The one-step rewrite relation →_R is defined by replacing an instance σ(l) of a left-hand side at some position in a term by σ(r); its reflexive–transitive closure is →_R*, and the parallel rewrite relation ⇒_R rewrites a finite set of pairwise-disjoint redex positions simultaneously in one step. R is Church-Rosser (confluent) if for all terms u, v, w with u →_R* v and u →_R* w there exists t with v →_R* t and w →_R* t.

A critical pair ⟨t, s⟩ of R arises from a non-variable overlap of two (renamed) rules of R: unifying a left-hand side l₁ with a non-variable subterm of another left-hand side l₂ via a most general unifier μ yields the two reducts t and s of μ(l₂).

Problem: Give a decidable criterion on the finite set of critical pairs of an arbitrary left-linear TRS R that is sufficient for R to be Church-Rosser. In particular, determine whether each of the following critical-pair conditions implies Church-Rosserness of every left-linear TRS:

(a) for every critical pair ⟨t, s⟩, s ⇒_R t (one parallel step);
(b) for every critical pair ⟨t, s⟩, s →_R^{=} t (zero or one steps);
(c) for every critical pair ⟨t, s⟩, either s →_R^{=} t or t →_R^{=} s.

Provide proofs or counterexamples, and identify other decidable sufficient critical-pair conditions ensuring the Church-Rosser property of left-linear term-rewriting systems.
artifact.status_search_result: Several decidable sufficient critical-pair criteria for Church-Rosser of left-linear TRSs have been established and refined: Huet's strong/parallel closedness, Toyama's parallel-critical-pair (parallel closedness) theorem, Okui's simultaneous-critical-pair criterion, Oyamaguchi–Ohta-style parallel closure criteria, and more recent extensions (e.g., to nominal and higher-order rewriting). Thus partial criteria exist and the cited specific conditions (parallel-step closedness, almost parallel closedness) are known to suffice. However, a complete decidable characterization of Church-Rosserness for arbitrary left-linear systems remains open (and is in general undecidable without further restrictions), so the broader problem of finding the strongest decidable critical-pair criterion remains an active research direction.

status_evidence.title: A new parallel closed condition for Church-Rosser of left-linear term rewriting systems
status_evidence.snippet: A parallel closed condition was developed for Church-Rosser of left-linear term rewriting systems based on parallel reduction of critical pairs.
status_evidence.claim: Decidable parallel-closure criteria for Church-Rosser of left-linear TRSs have been developed.

status_evidence.title: Simultaneous critical pairs and Church-Rosser property
status_evidence.snippet: Simultaneous critical pairs account for simultaneous overlapping of several rewrite rules; a new Church-Rosser criterion subsumes Toyama's parallel closedness.
status_evidence.claim: Stronger decidable critical-pair criteria continue to be discovered.

status_evidence.title: Confluence without termination via parallel critical pairs
status_evidence.snippet: A new criterion for confluence of possibly non-terminating left-linear TRSs based on strong joinability of parallel critical pairs.
status_evidence.claim: Parallel-critical-pair joinability gives sufficient decidable conditions for confluence of non-terminating left-linear systems.

status_evidence.title: Formalizing Simultaneous Critical Pairs for Confluence of Left-Linear Rewrite Systems
status_evidence.snippet: Recent formalization of simultaneous-critical-pair confluence criteria for left-linear TRSs.
status_evidence.claim: Research on these decidable criteria remains active.
